logo.label: Logo
logo.info: Upload a horizontal logo with transparent space around the mark.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.info: Use a square image that remains recognizable at small sizes.

background_gradient.label: Background gradient
background_gradient.info: Use only when it supports the brand and preserves readable text.

default_color_scheme.label: Default color scheme
default_color_scheme.info: Used by the storefront until a section chooses a different scheme.

enable_motion.label: Enable interface motion
enable_motion.info: System reduced-motion preferences always take priority.

motion_duration.label: Interface motion duration
motion_duration.info: Use shorter durations for a responsive, restrained experience.

text.label: Text
text.info: A legacy single message. Add announcement blocks for multiple messages.

link.label: Link
link.info: Optional destination for the announcement text.

enable_rotation.label: Rotate multiple messages
enable_rotation.info: Disabled by default. Rotation pauses when customers focus or hover over this bar.

menu.label: Main menu
menu.info: Choose the menu used for desktop and mobile navigation.

mobile_menu.label: Mobile menu
mobile_menu.info: Leave blank to use the main menu on mobile.

logo.label: Header logo
logo.info: Leave blank to use the logo from Brand settings.

transparent_logo.label: Transparent-state logo
transparent_logo.info: Used only while a transparent homepage header is active.

sticky_header.label: Enable sticky header
sticky_header.info: Keeps the header available while customers scroll.

hide_on_scroll.label: Hide while scrolling down
hide_on_scroll.info: The header returns as soon as a customer scrolls up.

transparent_homepage.label: Overlay the homepage hero
transparent_homepage.info: Uses a transparent header at the top of the homepage, then a solid header after scrolling.

enable_predictive_search.label: Show search suggestions
enable_predictive_search.info: Shows Shopify search suggestions while customers type.

show_localization.label: Show country and language selector
show_localization.info: Only appears when more than one country or language is available.

newsletter_heading.label: Newsletter heading
newsletter_heading.info: Uses the default newsletter heading when left empty.

show_localization.label: Show country and language selectors
show_localization.info: Selectors appear only when Shopify makes more than one option available.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Uses the selected menu name when left empty.

image.label: Desktop image
image.info: Use a high-resolution landscape image with a clear focal point.

mobile_image.label: Mobile image
mobile_image.info: Optional. Use a portrait crop when the desktop image does not work on small screens.

heading_tag.label: Heading level
heading_tag.info: H1 is used only when this is the first section; otherwise the section uses H2.

autoplay.label: Enable autoplay
autoplay.info: Autoplay pauses on hover, keyboard focus, when the tab is hidden, and for reduced-motion users.

desktop_image.label: Desktop image
desktop_image.info: Use a high-resolution landscape image with a clear focal point.

mobile_image.label: Mobile image
mobile_image.info: Optional. Use a portrait crop when the desktop image does not work on small screens.

heading_tag.label: Heading preference
heading_tag.info: H1 is used only for the first valid slide when this is the first homepage section. All other slide headings use H2.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Uses the selected collection title when left empty.

collection_link_label.label: Collection link label
collection_link_label.info: Uses the default collection link label when left empty.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Uses the default newsletter heading when left empty.

low_inventory_threshold.label: Low-stock threshold
low_inventory_threshold.info: A low-stock message appears only when Shopify tracks inventory, sales stop at zero, and the actual quantity is at or below this value.

low_inventory_message.label: Low-stock message
low_inventory_message.info: Optional. This message is shown only when the selected variant meets the low-stock threshold.

show_description.label: Show collection description below the filters
show_description.info: Disable this when the collection banner already shows the description.

enable_predictive_search.label: Enable search suggestions
enable_predictive_search.info: Suggestions appear after a customer enters at least two characters. The normal search form always remains available.

enable_cart_drawer.label: Enable cart drawer
enable_cart_drawer.info: When disabled, cart links continue directly to the cart page.

show_title.label: Show page title
show_title.info: Disable this when the page content already begins with its own page title.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Uses the page title when left empty.

description.label: Description
description.info: Optional introductory content for this blog.

mobile_image.label: Mobile image
mobile_image.info: Optional. Use a mobile-specific crop when needed.

show_rating.label: Show rating when available
show_rating.info: Ratings are shown only when a compatible product rating metafield is available.

enable_quick_add.label: Enable quick add
enable_quick_add.info: Single-variant products add directly. Products requiring options link to their product page.

sticky_information.label: Keep product information visible while scrolling

image_alt.label: Image description
image_alt.info: Describe the image when it conveys information; leave it empty when it is decorative.

company_name.label: Company name
company_name.info: Required for accessible logo text; it is not inferred from the image filename.

auto_rotate.label: Auto-rotate testimonials
auto_rotate.info: Off by default. Rotation pauses when a customer hovers or focuses the section.

accessible_label.label: Accessible label
accessible_label.info: Describe the destination when the image or caption does not make it clear.

video_title.label: Video title
video_title.info: Used as the accessible title for an embedded video.

autoplay.label: Autoplay
autoplay.info: Autoplay works only when the video is muted.

enable_faq_structured_data.label: Enable FAQ structured data
enable_faq_structured_data.info: Outputs FAQPage JSON-LD only for the visible questions and answers in this section.

highlighted_column.label: Highlighted column
highlighted_column.info: 0 means no highlighted column; 1–5 correspond to the visible column order.

sticky_first_column.label: Keep first column visible on mobile

comparison_table.name: Comparison table
comparison_table.instructions: Add Column blocks first, then Feature row blocks. Value 1–5 follow the Column block order.
